mechanism: Nalmefene is an opioid antagonist that may precipitate acute withdrawal symptoms in opioid-dependent patients; metoprolol may mask tachycardia symptoms of withdrawal, and both drugs can affect cardiovascular stability during acute withdrawal.
action: Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal (anxiety, agitation, diaphoresis, hypertension); ensure opioid dependence is properly assessed before nalmefene initiation; consider temporary beta-blocker adjustment if acute withdrawal occurs.
